capabilities: Review vault and GitLab changes in a source-control-style sidebar
Sync a vault or folder with one GitLab branch as a single commit
Resolve conflicts by choosing mine, theirs, or both
Connect a GitLab account and create projects via an access token
Download an existing GitLab project into a new vault
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not use git locally; all syncing happens through GitLab's HTTP API, so no git installation is needed.
extras: Warns against running it alongside Obsidian Sync, iCloud, Dropbox or Syncthing on the same vault; files over 20 MB are skipped by default; Git LFS is unsupported; releases carry signed GitHub build attestations; no telemetry.
problem: Keeping an Obsidian vault backed up or mirrored across devices via GitLab normally requires git, SSH keys and the command line, which mobile users lack.

relations.evidence: install it with BRAT, a plugin for installing plugins straight from GitHub
It talks to GitLab's API directly, so there's no git to install

requires.name: GitLab personal access token with api permission
BRAT (only until the plugin is in the directory)

summary: Syncs an Obsidian vault or one folder with a single GitLab branch through GitLab's API, with a review sidebar and manual conflict resolution.
